---
title: "Produce routine surveillance outputs"
subtitle: "Create controlled metrics, tabulations and briefings"
---

**Status:** Operational framework aligned with the implemented CVD workflows.
**Owner:** BNR Analyst.

## Purpose

Turn an approved data freeze into repeatable analytical products without mixing confidential computation with public presentation.

## Shared production pathway

1. Build the confidential cumulative dataset from the frozen source.
2. Create the approved de-identified analytical input datasets.
3. Run the selected product workflow.
4. Write results to a private staging package.
5. Review and approve the package separately.
6. Promote only approved public artefacts.
7. Render and deploy the Quarto site.

| **Dashboard metrics** | Stable reusable values for interactive views and downloads | [Technical dashboard workflow](../../technical/workflows/dashboards/overview.qmd) |

## Required controls

- Use the same release identifier and period throughout a run.
- Use version-controlled Stata code; do not calculate core published values in Quarto.
- Preserve the private log and staging package.
- Review warnings rather than relying only on a zero return code.
- Do not copy staging files into public or website folders.
- Do not manually edit generated datasets, tables, figures, metadata or ZIP files.

## If production fails

Stop at the failed stage, preserve the log and correct the source data, configuration or code. Rerun from the earliest affected stage. A partially created package has no approval status and must not be published.

## Evidence retained

The private workflow retains input and release identifiers, logs, staging files, review outputs and approval evidence. The public package retains only approved non-confidential datasets, figures, metadata and build information.
